selector.rationale: The presence of well-developed cornoid lamellae, individual cell dyskeratosis, and vacuolar degeneration of the basal cell layer in the histopathology findings supports Grover's disease, which is further reinforced by the clinical presentation of intensely pruritic papules.

rejected.label: Eruptive pruritic papular porokeratosis (EPPP)
rejected.why: Lack of specific supporting evidence in the provided notes and less typical clinical presentation compared to Grover's disease.

rejected.label: Darier's disease
rejected.why: While Darier's disease shares some histological features, the clinical presentation and specific histopathological findings like well-developed cornoid lamellae are more characteristic of Grover's disease.
